newsitem.title: USA: Corrections Corp to build 2 Georgia prisons.
newsitem.headline: Corrections Corp to build 2 Georgia prisons.

text.p: Corrections Corp of America said Friday it expects to realize $16.5 million in annual revenues following the opening of two new prisons it is building for the state of Georgia.
The company said it has contracted with the state to design, build and manage two 500-bed, medium-security prisons for adult men in Coffee and Wheeler counties, at a cost of $35 million.
The prisons will be financed and owned by Corrections Corp and are expected to open in the first quarter of 1999.

Corrections Corp manages prisons and other correctional institutions for governmental agencies. It operates 45,639 beds in 61 facilities under contract in the U.S., Puerto Rico, Australia and the United Kingdom.
